title: Harry Styles, Billie Eilish and Cher to Headline Glastonbury 2027
summary:
Glastonbury is back — and its 2027 line-up is already making waves. Harry Styles, Billie Eilish, Cher and Sam Fender will headline the famous festival at Worthy Farm in Pilton next summer.

The festival will run from 23 to 27 June 2027. For Styles, it will be his first time headlining Glastonbury. Eilish will be topping the bill for the second time, standing on the Pyramid Stage once again. Cher, who has not toured since 2020, will take the traditional legends slot on Sunday night.

The rest of the bill is packed too. Massive Attack, Lily Allen, Robyn, the XX, Chvrches, Kacey Musgraves, Lola Young, Sombr and Adéla are among the other acts announced so far.

Festival organiser Emily Eavis shared the news on Instagram. She said the team was happy to be coming back after the festival's fallow year — a year off that lets the fields rest — and wanted to give fans an early taste of what is to come. More names will be announced in the new year. She said the team was beyond excited about how the festival was shaping up and could not wait to see everyone down on the farm in June.

Tickets for 2027 cost £408, the first time the price has gone past £400. That is up from £378.50 in 2025. Even so, tickets sold out instantly when they went on sale on 4 October.

The line-up also settles some rumours. Oasis and Madonna will not be headlining. Madonna is heading to Coachella in April instead, while Oasis have their own global tour starting in May.
